lead: A comment-only edit to a member's implementing file makes every figure in that file stale, and the goal's own acceptance check then goes red on features the session never touched.
body: `rule:testing/member-perf-ledger` re-measures a figure when the implementing file's text moves with its `mod tests` cut off, so one `# Known gaps` paragraph added to `arr.rs` put nine green `Core\Arr` members back in the `perf` column of `python tools/dossier.py --group 'Core\Arr' --owed`. Close them with one `--record-perf` over the whole group after `verify.py` is green, rather than reading that column as new work.
